CSS

Recipes

A few things themes often want, ready to copy.

A CRT over everything

.rp-desk::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 160;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px);
}

A list as a drum, turning in 3D

.my-drum .rp-list-track { perspective: calc(var(--u) * 80); }
.my-drum .rp-item {
  transform: rotateX(calc(var(--rel) * -14deg)) translateZ(calc(var(--dist) * var(--u) * -4));
  opacity: calc(1 - var(--dist) * 0.18);
}

A color per system

/* In theme.json: "systems": { "megadrive": { "colors": { "accent": "#3a7bff" } } } — or in CSS: */
.rp-desk[data-focus-system='nes'] { --rp-accent: #e60012; }

The names under the covers

.rp-card-title {
  display: block;
  margin-top: calc(var(--u) * 1);
  font-size: calc(var(--u) * 1.5);
  text-align: center;
}

Another icon for a section

.rp-tab[data-tab='home'] svg { display: none; }
.rp-tab[data-tab='home']::before {
  content: '';
  width: calc(var(--u) * 2.2);
  height: calc(var(--u) * 2.2);
  background: url(icons/home.svg) center / contain no-repeat;
}

Hide what you don’t want

.rp-hero-blurb, .rp-card-marks, .rp-brand-name { display: none; }

Colors by an option

.rp-desk[data-opt-phosphor='amber'] {
  --rp-ink: #ffcf7a;
  --rp-accent: #ffb000;
}
